name: Scripture memory
summary: Memorize scripture with a spaced-repetition review schedule paced to the verses you choose.

onboarding.prompt: Which verses or theme do you want to memorize?
onboarding.reaction: Great choice. We'll set them in order.

onboarding.prompt: How do you like to practise?
onboarding.reaction: We'll match the reviews to that.

onboarding.prompt: Tap a short daily review time.

phases.name: Spaced review
benchmarks: Older verses still recalled at weekly review
actions: Reviews spaced out over days, then weeks

plan_blueprint.calendar: A daily 5-minute review at the chosen slot; older verses come back on a spaced schedule.

approach_variants.habit: Review stacked on a daily habit; streak.
approach_variants.time: Review time as a calendar block.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up cards or an app and a recitation partner.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed reviews push the verse back to the next day. After a week off, new verses pause until older ones are refreshed.
